panels.description: Hourly share of benchmark attempts blocked by host-pool capacity or exhausted volume write spools. Successful attempts publish zero and infrastructure failures publish one. Volume spool exhaustion remains a hard benchmark failure.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS "time", 100.0 * AVG((metrics->>'benchmark_error_count')::numeric) AS value, split_part(split_part(suite_name, '(', 2), ')', 1) || ' / ' || COALESCE(metrics->>'request_type', case_name) AS metric
FROM benchmark_results
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
  AND split_part(split_part(suite_name, '(', 2), ')', 1) IN (${environment:sqlstring})
  AND source = 'ci'
  AND run_name = 'benchmark-status'
GROUP BY 1, 3
ORDER BY 1
